goal: Report which scenarios a real integrated test covers, and draft specs for code that shipped without any

steps.title: Bind a scenario to a named test
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that a scenario naming a test that exists reports as bound to that test. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="Declared test binds to the scenario" packages/dod-guard/dist/cover-binding.test.js

steps.title: Report a scenario with no declared test as unbound
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that a scenario naming no test reports as unbound, and the report guesses at no test. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="A scenario with no declared test is unbound" packages/dod-guard/dist/cover-binding.test.js

steps.title: Report a declared test that does not exist as a broken binding
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that a scenario naming a missing test reports as a broken binding, naming both. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="A declared test that does not exist is an error" packages/dod-guard/dist/cover-binding.test.js

steps.title: Count a passing bound test as covering its scenario
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that a scenario whose every bound test passed reports as covered. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="Passing test covers its scenario" packages/dod-guard/dist/cover-results.test.js

steps.title: Report a scenario with a failing bound test as not covered
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that a scenario with a failing bound test reports as not covered and names that test. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="Failing test does not cover its scenario" packages/dod-guard/dist/cover-results.test.js

steps.title: Report a scenario whose only bound test was skipped as not covered
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that a scenario whose only bound test was skipped reports as not covered. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="Skipped test does not cover its scenario" packages/dod-guard/dist/cover-results.test.js

steps.title: Walk reachability from the declared entry points only
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that the walk starts from the declared entry points and from no others. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="Declared entry points drive the reachability walk" packages/dod-guard/dist/cover-entry-points.test.js

steps.title: Report integration as unchecked when a project declares no entry points
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that a project declaring none still reports covered or not covered, and states it checked no integration. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="A project with no declared entry points reports the gap" packages/dod-guard/dist/cover-entry-points.test.js

steps.title: Report a test reaching the implementation through an entry point as integrated
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that a passing test that calls a declared entry point which reaches the implementation reports as covered and integrated. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="Test through an entry point counts as integrated" packages/dod-guard/dist/cover-reach.test.js

steps.title: Report a test that bypasses every entry point as covered but not integrated
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that a passing test reaching the implementation through no declared entry point reports as covered but not integrated. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="Test that bypasses every entry point is reported" packages/dod-guard/dist/cover-reach.test.js

steps.title: Report an implementation no entry point reaches as unwired
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that an implementation no declared entry point reaches reports as unwired, distinct from covered but not integrated. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="Implementation no entry point reaches is reported" packages/dod-guard/dist/cover-reach.test.js

steps.title: Add the cover subcommand and report every scenario with one state
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that running cover on a change with spec deltas names every scenario, each with exactly one coverage state. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="Command reports every scenario in the change" packages/dod-guard/dist/cli.cover.test.js

steps.title: Exit 3 and name the id when the change id resolves to nothing
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that cover on an id that names no change exits 3 and names the id it could not find. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="Unknown change id is a usage error" packages/dod-guard/dist/cli.cover.test.js

steps.title: Exit 0 when the run finds uncovered scenarios
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that a run that finds uncovered scenarios reports them and exits 0. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="Uncovered scenarios still exit 0" packages/dod-guard/dist/cli.cover.test.js

steps.title: Exit 3 and name what could not be read on a broken run
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that a run that cannot read the change or the results exits 3 and names what it could not read. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="A broken run exits non-zero" packages/dod-guard/dist/cli.cover.test.js

steps.title: Add the backfill subcommand and draft requirements for a path
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that backfill on code with no spec writes a draft spec and names the source file and test behind each requirement. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="Command drafts requirements for a path" packages/dod-guard/dist/backfill.test.js

steps.title: Exit 3 and name the path when backfill gets a path that does not exist
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that backfill on a missing path exits 3 and names the path. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="A path that does not exist is a usage error" packages/dod-guard/dist/backfill.test.js

steps.title: Draft nothing for behavior an existing requirement already covers
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that behavior an existing requirement describes produces no draft, and the run reports which requirement covered it. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="Covered behavior produces no draft" packages/dod-guard/dist/backfill.test.js

steps.title: Draft only the uncovered part of a partly covered behavior
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that behavior an existing requirement covers in part drafts a scenario for the uncovered part only. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="Partly covered behavior drafts only the gap" packages/dod-guard/dist/backfill.test.js

steps.title: Name the source test file and case behind a draft
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that a requirement drafted from an existing test names that test file and the case within it. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="A draft from a test names that test" packages/dod-guard/dist/backfill-evidence.test.js

steps.title: State that no test backed a draft written from code alone
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that a requirement drafted from code no test exercises states that no test backed it. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="A draft from code alone says no test backed it" packages/dod-guard/dist/backfill-evidence.test.js

steps.title: Mark a freshly written draft as unconfirmed
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that a newly written drafted requirement carries an unconfirmed state. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="A fresh draft is unconfirmed" packages/dod-guard/dist/confirm-state.test.js

steps.title: Report a scenario under an unconfirmed requirement as unconfirmed
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that cover reports a scenario under an unconfirmed requirement as unconfirmed rather than covered. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="An unconfirmed requirement does not satisfy coverage" packages/dod-guard/dist/confirm-state.test.js

steps.title: Treat a confirmed requirement the same as a hand-written one
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that a confirmed requirement loses its drafted mark and every later command treats it as hand-written. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="A confirmed requirement behaves like any other" packages/dod-guard/dist/confirm-state.test.js

steps.title: Leave a confirmed requirement untouched and report a contradiction
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that code contradicting a confirmed requirement leaves it untouched and reports the contradiction. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="Code that contradicts a confirmed requirement is reported" packages/dod-guard/dist/backfill.test.js

steps.title: Add no new draft on a second run over unchanged code
steps.description: Implement the behavior and write the named test so that a second run on unchanged code adds no new drafted requirement. Run `npm run build -w packages/dod-guard` before the verification, because the proof runs the compiled test under dist.
steps.verify_cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern="A second run does not duplicate its own earlier drafts" packages/dod-guard/dist/backfill.test.js
